scripts.text:
^3355FFThere are signs that show
that some violent scuffle
might have occurred here,
but you can't tell what had
happened exactly...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这里有一些迹象，表明可能发生过激烈的打斗，
但无法确切知道发生了什么...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find traces of poison
used in a battle. You sense
its potency and decide not
to get too close to it.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你发现了战斗中使用的毒物痕迹。
你感受到了它的毒性，决定不要靠得太近。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find traces of poison
used in a battle. A feeling
of acute dizziness overcomes
you after examining the scene.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你发现了战斗中使用的毒物痕迹。
在检查现场后，一阵剧烈的眩晕感袭来。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find traces of poison
used in a battle. A feeling
of acute dizziness overcomes
you after examining the scene.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你发现了战斗中使用的毒物痕迹。
在检查现场后，一阵剧烈的眩晕感袭来。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find traces of poison
used in a battle. You sense
its potency and decide not
to get too close to it.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你发现了战斗中使用的毒物痕迹。
你感受到了它的毒性，决定不要靠得太近。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere are traces of a battle
that seem to be leading in
different directions. From the
peculiar smell that permeates
the area, it seems that some
kind of lethal poison was used.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这里的战斗痕迹似乎指向不同的方向。
从弥漫在空气中的特殊气味来看，
似乎使用了一种致命的毒药。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFStill...
The trail of this
battle decidedly
heads southward.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF不过...
这场战斗的痕迹
明确地指向南方。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find signs of
a heated pursuit
that head south.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你发现了一些激烈的追逐迹象，
它们指向南方。

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere are signs that show
that some violent scuffle
might have occurred here,
but you can't tell what had
happened exactly...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这里有一些迹象，表明可能发生过激烈的打斗，
但无法确切知道发生了什么...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere are signs
that many people
have traveled through
this particular area.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这里有迹象表明，
许多人曾经过这个区域。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou've found traces
of the pursuit which
continue eastward.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你发现了追逐的痕迹，
它们继续向东延伸。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThese traces of
the pursuit lead
towards the east.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这些追逐的痕迹
指向东方。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThese look like
traces of some kind
of pursuit or battle, but
you can't really tell for sure.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这些看起来像是某种追逐或战斗的痕迹，
但你无法确定。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere are signs
that many people
have traveled through
this particular area.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这里有迹象表明，
许多人曾经过这个区域。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou examine these traces
and notice that one set of
footprints looks almost too
pronounced, as if it had been
made for somebody to find.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你检查了这些痕迹，
注意到一组脚印看起来过于明显，
仿佛是为了让人发现而留下的。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt's a very
strange looking
set of footprints.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这是一组
非常奇怪的脚印。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere are signs that show
that some violent scuffle
might have occurred here,
but you can't tell what had
happened exactly...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这里有一些迹象，表明可能发生过激烈的打斗，
但无法确切知道发生了什么...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere are signs
that many people
have traveled through
this particular area.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这里有迹象表明，
许多人曾经过这个区域。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFFrom these traces,
you see that another
set of footprints has
been added. It looks like
someone else got involved.
These prints are distinctly
clearer and much smaller.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF从这些痕迹中，
你看到又增加了一组脚印。
看起来有其他人介入了。
这些脚印更加清晰，而且小得多。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFFrom these traces,
you see that another
person has gotten involved
in this heated scuffle.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF从这些痕迹中，
你看到有另一个人
介入了这场激烈的打斗。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThese look like
traces of some kind
of pursuit or battle, but
you can't really tell for sure.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这些看起来像是某种追逐或战斗的痕迹，
但你无法确定。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere are signs
that many people
have traveled through
this particular area.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这里有迹象表明，
许多人曾经过这个区域。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe traces of the battle
now split and head towards
the north and south. However,^000000
^3355FFthere is a puddle of strong poison that you must neutralize before you can investigate this scene.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF战斗的痕迹现在分成了两路，
分别指向北方和南方。然而，^000000
^3355FF有一滩强烈的毒药，你必须先将其中和，才能调查这个现场。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFFortunately, you can
temporarily nullify the
poison by using one
of your Green Potions.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF幸运的是，你可以使用一瓶
绿色药水来临时中和毒药。^000000

scripts.text: Use Green Potion.
scripts.translation: 使用绿色药水

scripts.text: Don't use it.
scripts.translation: 不使用

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe poison weakens
and some of it evaporates,
revealing a piece of cloth that
was hidden in that puddle.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF毒药减弱了，部分蒸发了，
露出了隐藏在那滩毒液中的一块布料。^000000

scripts.text: Don't investigate.
scripts.translation: 不调查

scripts.text: Investigate.
scripts.translation: 调查

scripts.text:
[{0}]
A piece of cloth
is nothing to be
concerned about.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
一块布料而已，
没什么好担心的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey... There's
blood on this cloth
and some writing on
it that I can't recognize.
Hopefully, this'll provide
some sort of clue to all this?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嘿...这块布上有血迹，
还有一些我不认识的文字。
希望这能成为解开谜团的线索？

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou take the piece
of cloth from the puddle
of poison and keep it with you.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你从毒液中捡起那块布料，
并把它收好。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hmm...
It'll probably be
faster if I follow this
trail, rather than stop to
investigate this scene.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...
与其停下来调查现场，
不如直接顺着痕迹追过去，
那样可能更快。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou can't find
anything else here,
aside from the traces
that split and lead both
northward and southward.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF除了分向南北的痕迹外，
你在这里没发现其他东西。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThese look like
traces of some kind
of pursuit or battle, but
you can't really tell for sure.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这些看起来像是某种追逐或战斗的痕迹，
但你无法确定。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere are signs
that many people
have traveled through
this particular area.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这里有迹象表明，
许多人曾经过这个区域。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThese footprints
look like they're
heading towards the
north from the south.
But you can't really
be sure just yet.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这些脚印看起来是从南向北延伸的。
但你还不能确定。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThese look like
traces of some kind
of pursuit or battle, but
you can't really tell for sure.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这些看起来像是某种追逐或战斗的痕迹，
但你无法确定。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere are signs
that many people
have traveled through
this particular area.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这里有迹象表明，
许多人曾经过这个区域。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe trail here looks pretty
muddled, since it looks like
they battled here for quite a
while. But the footprints are
definitely heading south.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这里的痕迹看起来很混乱，
似乎在这里发生了长时间的战斗。
但脚印明显是向南延伸的。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThese look like
traces of some kind
of pursuit or battle, but
you can't really tell for sure.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这些看起来像是某种追逐或战斗的痕迹，
但你无法确定。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere are two
distinct sets of
footprints in this
area, but they don't
hold any significance
right about now.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这个区域有两组明显的脚印，
但暂时看不出什么意义。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFAround here, it
looks like there are
only two sets of footprints.
What happened to the other
set that you found earlier?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这里看起来只有两组脚印。
之前发现的那组脚印去哪了？^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFFrom the evidence
that you've found here,
it looks like the battle
involves only two people
from this point onward.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF根据你在这里发现的证据，
从这一点开始，
这场战斗似乎只涉及两个人。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThese look like
traces of some kind
of pursuit or battle, but
you can't really tell for sure.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这些看起来像是某种追逐或战斗的痕迹，
但你无法确定。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFTraces of some
sort of battle are
scattered all over
this particular area.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这个特定区域散落着
战斗的痕迹。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou follow the trail
and although traces from
the north and southeast mix
together, it looks like the battle continues towards the east.
But you should check this
spot a little bit more...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你顺着痕迹追踪，
虽然来自北方和东南方的痕迹交织在一起，
但看起来战斗是向东继续的。
不过你应该再仔细检查一下这个地方...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFAfter investigating this
area more thoroughly,
you find another piece of
cloth stained with blood.
You decide to keep it with
you, hoping that it will
provide more clues.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF在更彻底地调查这个区域后，
你发现了另一块染血的布料。
你决定把它收好，
希望能提供更多线索。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou don't find anything,
but you still can't shake
the feeling that there is
some important clue that
you have to find here. It won't hurt to keep investigating here.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你什么也没发现，
但总觉得这里有什么重要线索。
继续调查也无妨。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou better continue
following this trail
which leads westward.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你最好继续沿着
向西延伸的痕迹追踪。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThese look like
traces of some kind
of pursuit or battle, but
you can't really tell for sure.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这些看起来像是某种追逐或战斗的痕迹，
但你无法确定。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere are signs
showing that a lot
of people were in
this area earlier.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF有迹象表明，
之前有很多人在这个区域。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe lead set of footprints,
probably belonging to the one
who was being pursued, look
more erratic, as if exhaustion
and desperation were setting in. These traces lead to the west.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF作为领头的那组脚印，
可能属于被追赶的人，
看起来更加凌乱，
仿佛疲惫和绝望正在蔓延。
这些痕迹通向西方。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe trail from
this point heads
towards the west.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF从这一点开始，
痕迹通向西方。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThese look like
traces of some kind
of pursuit or battle, but
you can't really tell for sure.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这些看起来像是某种追逐或战斗的痕迹，
但你无法确定。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere are signs
showing that a lot
of people were in
this area earlier.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF有迹象表明，
之前有很多人在这个区域。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFFollowing the
trail, you see signs
that blood was spilled
in this area. It looks like
someone was injured
pretty badly around here.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF顺着痕迹追踪，
你看到这里有血迹。
看起来有人在这里受了重伤。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFSince someone involved
in this conflict was bleeding,
further traces of this pursuit
might be easier to find now.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF由于卷入这场冲突的人正在流血，
现在或许更容易找到这次追逐的更多痕迹。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThese look like
traces of some kind
of pursuit or battle, but
you can't really tell for sure.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这些看起来像是某种追逐或战斗的痕迹，
但你无法确定。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere are signs
showing that a lot
of people were in
this area earlier.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF有迹象表明，
之前有很多人在这个区域。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThese traces lead
northward and it looks
like whoever is doing
the chasing is getting
much closer to his prey.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这些痕迹向北延伸，
看起来追赶者正离猎物越来越近。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe trail of this
pursuit now leads
towards the north.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这次追逐的痕迹
现在指向北方。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThese look like
traces of some kind
of pursuit or battle, but
you can't really tell for sure.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这些看起来像是某种追逐或战斗的痕迹，
但你无法确定。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere are signs
showing that a lot
of people were in
this area earlier.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF有迹象表明，
之前有很多人在这个区域。^000000

scripts.text: A large group of people seem to have gone by.
scripts.translation: 似乎有一大群人从这里经过。

scripts.text:
^3355FFJudging from these
traces, it looks like
even more people have
joined the battle which
now seems to be leading
in the southwest direction.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF根据这些痕迹判断，
似乎又有更多人加入了战斗，
战斗的走向似乎正朝西南方向延伸。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt looks like
the battle heads
towards the southwest
from this particular point.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF看起来战斗
正从这一点
朝西南方向延伸。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThese look like
traces of some kind
of pursuit or battle, but
you can't really tell for sure.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这些看起来像是某种追逐或战斗的痕迹，
但你无法确定。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere are signs
showing that a lot
of people were in
this area earlier.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF有迹象表明，
之前有很多人在这个区域。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFIn this area, it looks
like even more people
joined in this battle and
the pursuit clearly heads
towards the south.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF在这个区域，
似乎又有更多人加入了战斗，
追逐的路线明显指向南方。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe trail of
this battle heads
towards the south.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这场战斗的痕迹
指向南方。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThese look like
traces of some kind
of pursuit or battle, but
you can't really tell for sure.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这些看起来像是某种追逐或战斗的痕迹，
但你无法确定。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere are signs
showing that a lot
of people were in
this area earlier.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF有迹象表明，
之前有很多人在这个区域。^000000

scripts.text: A large group of people seem to have gone by.
scripts.translation: 似乎有一大群人从这里经过。

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis area is clearly
marked with signs
of a violent battle, with
traces of poison strewn
all over the ground.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这个区域明显留有
激烈战斗的痕迹，
地面上到处散落着毒药的残留。^000000

scripts.text: Continue following the traces.
scripts.translation: 继续追踪痕迹

scripts.text: Further investigate the area.
scripts.translation: 进一步调查该区域

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou examine the
trail, but can't really
discern the direction
in which the battle
continues...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你检查了痕迹，
但无法分辨战斗
继续延伸的方向...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find a bunch of
traps that use different
kinds of poison. The ones
that have been set off are
mixed with the ones which
haven't been triggered.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你发现了一堆
使用不同种类毒药的陷阱。
被触发的陷阱
与未被触发的混在一起。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFOne trap in particular
stands out to you more
than the rest. Perhaps
you should pour some
Green Potion on it to
neutralize it first.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF其中一个陷阱
格外显眼。
也许你应该先倒一些
绿色药水
来中和它。^000000

scripts.text: Pour Green Potion.
scripts.translation: 倒上绿色药水

scripts.text: Don't use Green Potion.
scripts.translation: 不使用绿色药水

scripts.text:
^3355FFUnfortunately, you
don't have a Green
Potion that you can
use to pour on this trap...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF不幸的是，
你没有可以倒在这个陷阱上的
绿色药水...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFPouring that
Green Potion didn't
really make anything
happen. Perhaps you
should try something else.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF倒上那瓶
绿色药水后
并没有发生什么。
也许你应该试试别的办法。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I guess...
I'll try investigating
this area a little more?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想...
我再仔细调查一下这个区域？

scripts.text:
^3355FFBy sheer accident,
you set off one of
the traps in the area.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF由于意外，
你触发了该区域的一个陷阱。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou try grinding
a Green Herb and
sprinkling it on the
trap and then place
a Red Gemstone on it.
The gem glows and
slowly melts away...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你尝试研磨绿色药草，
将其撒在陷阱上，
然后放上一块红色魔力矿石。
宝石发出光芒，
并缓缓融化...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFAlthough you don't
fully understand the
science of using poisons
or antidotes, you managed
to successfully dismantle
the trap. Now you can safely
check what might be inside.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF虽然你并不完全理解
使用毒药或解毒剂的原理，
但你成功拆除了陷阱。
现在你可以安全地
查看里面有什么了。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou should try to
dismantle this trap
by using other catalysts
related to the curing or
use of poison. You do have
a Green Herb on you, so you
try sprinkling it on the trap.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你应该尝试使用与解毒或
使用毒药相关的其他催化剂
来拆除这个陷阱。
你身上正好有绿色药草，
于是你试着将它撒在陷阱上。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFHowever, nothing
happens. It seems that
you need another catalyst
in addition to the Green Herb
that you have in order to
dismantle this trap.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF然而，什么也没发生。
看来除了你手中的绿色药草，
你还需要另一种催化剂
才能拆除这个陷阱。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou should try to
dismantle this trap
by using other catalysts
related to the curing or use
of poison. You do have a
Red Gemstone, so you grind
it and sprinkle it on the trap.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你应该尝试使用与解毒或
使用毒药相关的其他催化剂
来拆除这个陷阱。
你身上正好有红色魔力矿石，
于是你将其研磨后撒在陷阱上。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFHowever, nothing
happens. It seems that
you need another catalyst to
use with the Red Gemstone
that you have in order to
dismantle this trap.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF然而，什么也没发生。
看来除了你手中的红色魔力矿石，
你还需要另一种催化剂
才能拆除这个陷阱。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou should try to
dismantle this trap
by using other catalysts
related to the curing or
use of poison. But what
items should you bring?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你应该尝试使用与解毒或
使用毒药相关的其他催化剂
来拆除这个陷阱。
但是，你应该带些什么物品呢？^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFInside the dismantled
trap, you find another
piece of strange cloth
that's stained with blood.
You take it with you in
hopes that it provides
some kind of evidence.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF在拆开的陷阱里，
你发现了一块沾满血迹的
奇怪布料碎片。
你把它收好，
希望能从中找到一些线索。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou examine the area
a little further and guess
that the battle might head
towards the south.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你进一步勘察了周围，
推测战斗可能
向南方延伸。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThese look like
traces of some kind
of pursuit or battle, but
you can't really tell for sure.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这些看起来像是某种追逐或战斗的痕迹，
但你无法确定。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere are signs
that a large group
of people have been in
this area for some reason.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这里有一些迹象，
表明有一大群人
曾出于某种原因
在此处停留。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThese traces lead
to the edge of the cliff.
marking the end of the trail.
Apparently, the one who was
being chased met his fate here.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这些痕迹一直延伸到
悬崖边缘，
标志着线索的终点。
显然，被追捕的人
在这里遭遇了不幸。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere are many footprints
leading to the edge of the
cliff and all of them leave
this scene, save for the set
of footprints that distinctly
belong to the person who
was pursued all this time...^3355FF
scripts.translation:
^3355FF有许多脚印通向悬崖边缘，
它们都离开了现场，
唯独那组明显属于
一直被追捕者的脚印...
^3355FF

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt looks like you've
learned all that you can
from this investigation. You
better return and report your
findings to Yierhan soon.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF看起来你已经从这次调查中
获取了所有能获取的信息。
你最好尽快回去，
向叶尔汗汇报你的发现。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis is the end
of the trail. There
aren't any more traces
of the battle left to find.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这里是线索的终点。
没有更多战斗的痕迹
可供寻找了。^000000
